The Étoile philosophy

A celestial beauty house for the modern woman.

Inspired by the quiet elegance of the Arabian night sky, the softness of desert light, and Abu Dhabi’s culture of refined hospitality, Étoile transforms beauty care into a private ritual. Our approach begins with listening: to your style, your skin, your routine, and the way you wish to feel.

Private by design

Discreet ladies-only care, including a setting thoughtfully suited to women who wear hijab.

Expertly personal

Every service begins with an individual consultation and a tailored care plan.

Warmly Abu Dhabi

A welcome ritual inspired by Emirati hospitality, delivered with grace and calm.

Our expertise

Two worlds of care. One radiant you.

From precision hair artistry to restorative skin rituals, Étoile combines technical expertise with a luxurious, unhurried experience.
